actual: MA-E19R3 direct-v2 config pins market=stock_universe, but minute coverage and Qlib Exchange default to all when exchange_kwargs.codes is omitted. Since daily all.txt correctly catalogs 000300.SH while minute data remains stock-only, the pre-training minute coverage gate incorrectly requires 000300.SH minute bars and blocks the run. Fix the consumer contract without modifying Qlib or candidate data: the default exchange quote universe must bind to the configured market/stock pool, while explicit wider quote_universe_codes remains supported and fail-closed coverage validation remains intact.
